06494 P@qachyah {pek-akh-yaw'}

源自 06491 和  03050; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Pekahiah 3; 3

比加轄 = "耶和華看見"
1) 北國以色列王米拿現的兒子, 他繼承了王位, 成為以色列的第十七任國王,
   在位二年後被其手下的將軍比加所殺 (#王下 15:22-23,26|)
record.edic_text:
06494 P@qachyah {pek-akh-yaw'}

from 06491 and 03050;; n pr m

AV - Pekahiah 3; 3

Pekahiah = "Jehovah sees"
1) son of king Menahem of the northern kingdom of Israel, succeeded
   to the throne as the 17th king and ruled for 2 years when he was
   murdered by one of the captains of his army, Pekah
